_about: House promos: our own billboards for ad slots with nothing paid to show. A slot shows a direct sponsor first, then an AdSense ad once Google actually fills it, then one of these. Labelled 'From The Learning Curve', never 'Advertisement'. Rules: docs/ads.md.

promos.headline: Get featured in our newsletter
promos.text: Each month we feature products, courses and learning discoveries from subscribers picked at random, plus the latest research on learning.

promos.headline: Which learning principles hold up?
promos.text: Every principle in our library, rated by the strength of its evidence, with what to do in a course.

promos.headline: An online course design checklist, grounded in the research
promos.text: Seven checks to run before you build: objectives, assessment, practice, feedback and a pilot.

promos.headline: Compare learning platforms on the evidence
promos.text: LMS platforms, course platforms and AI tools, with the source and date behind every fact.

promos.headline: Plan where every key idea gets recalled again
promos.text: A Google Sheet that maps recall across your modules, so nothing important is tested once and forgotten. Part of our free course design kit.

promos.headline: Turn a vague goal into objectives learners can meet
promos.text: A learning objectives builder with verbs matched to the level of thinking you want, plus six more evidence-based templates.

promos.headline: Storyboard and script each lesson, screen by screen
promos.text: A lesson storyboard and a script sheet built on cognitive load and dual coding, plus five more templates. Free Google Docs and Sheets.

promos.headline: Score your course against 24 evidence-based checks
promos.text: A course design audit that shows where to fix first, plus seven templates for the rest of the build. Free Google Docs and Sheets.

promos.headline: Plan for beginners and experts in the same course
promos.text: A mixed-audience planner: where beginners get worked examples and where experienced learners can skip ahead. Plus six more templates.

promos.headline: Eight evidence cards: what works, and what to do on Monday
promos.text: One printable page per learning principle, with how strong the evidence is. Plus seven templates for building your course.
